$comment: Coverage matrix — spec versioning-test-coverage, task 12.1 (design §3.5). Makes 'complete coverage' auditable: 9 versioned resources x 10 mandatory journeys (requirements §7). Each cell records the coverage LEVEL ('component' now — E2E is deferred per design ADR 7.4, so cells whose full flow only e2e would prove stay 'component' with a note; 'n/a' when the journey does not apply to the resource class), the real test files that exercise it (coveredBy, paths relative to repo root, verified by inspection — no invented coverage), and an honest status: 'covered' (observable behavior of the journey asserted at the stated level), 'partial' (some segments asserted, gaps listed in note), 'missing' (no real test exercises it). Verified in CI by the script from task 12.2 (a plugged resource without a matrix row fails the gate).
specRef: specs/versioning-test-coverage — requirements.md §7 (J1–J10), design.md §3.5 (matrix) and ADR 7.4 (e2e deferred)

levels.component: unit/component tests (Vitest today; Vitest browser-mode functional as it lands in src/tests/functional/)
levels.e2e: full journey through the real app (Playwright) — DEFERRED, no cell may claim it yet
levels.n/a: journey does not apply to the resource class

resources.notes: Composite: versioned sub-resources (cache settings, rules engine, functions, device groups) under src/services/v2/edge-app/versioned/. Wave 1 closed the former gap: dedicated edge-app-version-service/adapter tests now exist alongside the shared-suite entries and the generic createVersionAdapter tests (incl. PBT).
saveStrategy: auto-build on PUT, no /build endpoint (AUTO_BUILD_ON_SAVE); kebab Build navigates with ?intent=build. Rollback bypasses the base hook but still invalidates (regression-tested).
saveStrategy: SAVE hits the BASE resource endpoint, not the version updateDraft (req 6.5).
Composite: versioned firewall sub-resources (versioned-firewall-sub-resource-service) scoped by (resourceId, versionId) — req 6.4.
RESOURCE_CAPABILITY.function = VERSIONED_ONLY — no Deploy/Promote/Rollback affordances anywhere.
RESOURCE_CAPABILITY.waf = VERSIONED_ONLY. Composite: versioned WAF exceptions (versioned-waf-exceptions-service) scoped by (resourceId, versionId) — req 6.4.

Special case: DeploymentVersionService extends VersionServiceBase but points at deployment-api (baseURL /deployment-api/v4/deployments) and invalidateAfterMutation additionally invalidates deployments.detail. Versions are produced by releases; 'revert' generates a new version (analogue of NEW_DRAFT_FROM); deploy itself is the release composer.

J1.note: createDraft mutation + invalidation (shared service contract) and now dedicated edge-app tests: createDraft POST with the mapped payload, clone maps sourceVersionId/comment, bare clone omits resource fields (empty-vs-clone closed in Wave 1). Gap: "new draft opens in the editor" navigation (functional/e2e).

J2.note: Application SAVE updates the draft (explicit case); dedicated edge-app tests assert updateDraft PATCH with the root-modules payload and the adapter form→payload mapping; updateDraft/patchDraft invalidation. Wave 1 closed the shared gaps: invalid SAVE rejects and never touches the service (req 2.5, form-adapter lifecycle) and a disabled Save renders disabled and dispatches nothing (req 3.1, functional action bar). PBT hardens transformDraftPayload (stripUndefined at every depth).

J3.note: SAVE_AND_BUILD order save→build asserted (explicit Application case) + dedicated edge-app build endpoint test; kebab BUILD hits /build directly. Wave 1 added the generic save→build ordering (form-adapter lifecycle) and post-command navigation (edit screen returns to the versions list with a success toast). Remaining gap: rendered building/queued state badge in the listing.

J4.note: CANCEL_BUILD routed to service + cancelBuild invalidation + dedicated edge-app cancelBuild endpoint test. Wave 1: ProcessingOverlay rendered while building, hidden when ready, Cancel emits cancel (functional dialogs suite).

J5.note: NEW_DRAFT_FROM handler routes to service; kebab menu row present per state. Wave 1 closed navigate-to-new-draft (edit screen routes to the newly created version). Remaining gap: editor remount via :key.

J6.note: Comment contract, archive invalidation + base guard (empty comment rejects), 'in use' backend rejection surfaces a toast with no success/reload — all asserted at component level (shared shell path). Wave 1: rendered dialog (confirm disabled until a comment is typed) in the functional dialogs suite.

J7.note: Destructive confirm dialog (deletes only after confirmation), deleteVersion invalidation, rejection keeps list intact (no success/reload) — component level. Wave 1: destructive confirm rendered (DELETE confirms without a comment) in the functional dialogs suite.

J8.note: DEPLOY registered by capability, heading/footer buttons rendered, kebab DEPLOY routes to the composer scoped to the version, PROMOTE opens the drawer pinned to the version. Wave 1 functional: heading Deploy renders and routes to the composer (explicit + resource-scoped route); action bar Deploy/Redeploy per state; deploy-resource-context builds the drawer context and version options.

J9.note: Structural governance (every versioned form consumes the central readOnly) + state machine gating + Wave 1 rendered proof: a control consuming the version context renders disabled and a real click cannot toggle it (functional readonly-context). summary.$comment: Cell counts (9 resources x 10 journeys = 90 cells). Recomputed by the task 12.2 verification script (scripts/check-coverage-matrix.mjs); keep in sync when editing cells. Wave 1 landed the functional (browser-mode) suites in src/tests/functional/ (action bar, dialogs/overlay, heading actions, list data view, readonly context, keyboard focus), the edge-app and deployment version service/adapter tests, the form-adapter lifecycle suite and the PBTs — upgrade cells further as journey-level functional tests land.
